query:
INSERT INTO issue_comment_reactions (id, comment_id, issue_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)
            SELECT $1, $2, issue_id, $3, $4, $5
            FROM issue_comments
            WHERE id = $2
            RETURNING
                id          AS "id!: Uuid",
                comment_id  AS "comment_id!: Uuid",
                user_id     AS "user_id!: Uuid",
                emoji       AS "emoji!",
                created_at  AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
